T: A woman's place is on home, first, second, and third.
D: A dairy-farm catcher and her kid sister join the women's professional baseball league set up while the men are away at war.
P: Serve the slice when Jimmy tells Evelyn off in the dugout.
S: Cheddar and mustard grilled cheese bites. Dottie and Kit milking cows in Oregon.

Spread the bread with mustard and pile the cheddar on half the slices, then close. Butter the outsides and toast in a pan over medium heat until golden and melting. Cut into fingers and serve with the relish.
Pork and beef meatballs in red sauce on soft rolls, for Betty Spaghetti.

Mix both minces with the breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, half the garlic and salt, and roll into 16 balls. Brown the meatballs in the oil, then add the passata, oregano and remaining garlic. Simmer gently until the meatballs are cooked through and the sauce thickens. Tuck two meatballs and sauce into each roll with half a slice of provolone.
M: Splits catch ballpark hot dog plate
Franks with golden onions. Dottie catches a pop fly in the splits.

Cook the onions slowly in the butter with a pinch of salt until soft and golden. Grill the franks, turning, until blistered and hot through. Toast the rolls in the pan. Fill and top with onions, mustard and relish.
Pulled pork rolls with slaw. Marla meets Nelson on the roadhouse night.

Rub the pork with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder and salt and sit it in a lidded pot with the apple juice. Cover and cook at 160C until it pulls apart easily. Shred the pork with two forks and stir through the barbecue sauce and some pan juices. Toss the cabbage and apple with the mayo, then fill the rolls with pork, slaw and pickles.
W: No crying in baseball candy bar slice
Chocolate caramel slice on a biscuit base, for the Peaches dugout.

Mix the biscuit crumbs with half the butter and press into a lined slice tin. Stir the condensed milk, golden syrup, sugar and remaining butter over low heat until thick and golden. Stir in the peanuts, pour over the base and bake at 170C for 10 minutes, then cool. Melt the chocolate with the oil, pour over and chill until set, then slice.
K: Peach nectar topped with cold beer. Jimmy was told not to drink.
Half fill 4 chilled glasses with the peach nectar. Top slowly with the lager and add a squeeze of lemon.
